title: Recursive Language Models
summary: How a model can answer questions about inputs 30 times longer than it can read: the prompt goes into a Python variable, and the model writes code that reads it in pieces and calls itself on them. Six live figures, every number from the paper.

source.label: Zhang, Kraska and Khattab, “Recursive Language Models”, arXiv:2512.24601v2, 2026
